caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical hatbox with a muted tan color as the primary hue. The box features a decorative band at the top with the word "STETSON HATS" written in large, capitalized, serif letters. The body of the hatbox is illustrated with architectural and urban scenes: on the left side, there is the Arc de Triomphe, labeled "PARIS," in light gray and cream tones with accents of green trees around its base. At the center and right, there is a depiction of Independence Hall, labeled "PHILADELPHIA," rendered in reddish-brown for the building, green for the surrounding trees, and cream for the architectural details. Behind Independence Hall, there are light blue and gray high-rise buildings suggesting a cityscape. The box also has a faint curved pink handle attached near Independence Hall. At the bottom of the box, a decorative scroll motif runs along the edge. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Bandbox
